blocks.en: In this subsection, we shall show that $C^{\infty}$-functions with bounded support are dense in $H^k(\Omega)$. No assumptions on boundary regularity are needed. The same proofs work for $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$ if $p<\infty$. We first show that functions with bounded support are dense; of course, this is only of interest if $\Omega$ is unbounded.
blocks.zh: 本小节证明具有有界支集的 $C^{\infty}$ 函数在 $H^k(\Omega)$ 中稠密. 不需要对边界正则性作任何假设. 若 $p<\infty$, 同样的证明适用于 $W^{k,p}(\Omega)$. 先证明有界支集函数稠密; 当然, 只有当 $\Omega$ 无界时这一点才值得关注.

blocks.en: Hence any function in $H^k(\Omega)$ can be approximated by functions whose derivatives exist in the classical sense. This is often useful in proofs. One can do everything for smooth functions first and then argue the general case by taking limits. However, Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-interior-smooth-density} is still unsatisfactory. In many cases one would like to have approximation by functions which are smooth up to the boundary, rather than just in the interior of $\Omega$. This cannot be done without some assumptions on the boundary of $\Omega$. The result we give now is not optimal, but will suffice for our purposes.
blocks.zh: 因此, $H^k(\Omega)$ 中任意函数都可由导数在经典意义下存在的函数逼近. 这在证明中往往很有用. 可以先对光滑函数完成全部论证, 再通过取极限讨论一般情形. 然而, Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-interior-smooth-density} 仍不令人满意. 在许多情况下, 希望由直到边界都光滑的函数逼近, 而不仅仅在 $\Omega$ 内部光滑. 若不对 $\Omega$ 的边界作某些假设, 就无法做到这一点. 现在给出的结果并非最优, 但足以满足这里的需要.

blocks.en: Assume that $\Omega$ has the $k$-extension property. Then functions in $C^{\infty}(\overline\Omega)$ with bounded support are dense in $H^k(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 假设 $\Omega$ 具有 $k$ 阶延拓性质. 那么 $C^{\infty}(\overline\Omega)$ 中具有有界支集的函数在 $H^k(\Omega)$ 中稠密.
blocks.label: lem:sobolev-extension-boundary-smooth-density
